name: the Class written: ONE query at the frame end; the rows become Items, Success
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts — the Class setter schedules; the frame's one query; the success publishes

name: nothing written: no query, ever; Items undefined, Is Empty true, Count 0
because: no setter ran, nothing scheduled

name: Do with nothing written queries anyway — collection undefined
because: storageFetch → scheduleFetch, no guard; the editor's warning only

name: Class, Search, a filter and its parameter in one frame: one query carrying all of them
because: scheduleFetch coalesces; the neutral filter on the wire

name: the same Class again does not re-query (DEF-046); Do does
because: setCollectionName compares; storageFetch does not

name: the visual filter written again with the same value re-queries — no comparison on the panel's two editors
because: setVisualFilter / setVisualSorting ask only the Query settings box

name: Use limit with no Limit or Skip: limit 10, skip 0; Limit 2 then narrows
because: getStorageLimit / getStorageSkip — `|| 10`, `|| 0`

name: Limit without Use limit is not sent
because: getStorageLimit returns nothing unless Use limit is on

name: Fetch total count: the call asks for it, and the answer's total is re-sent on Total Count
because: getStorageFetchTotalCount; the success stores the count and flags storageTotalCount

name: a connected rule whose parameter has supplied nothing does not narrow the query
because: savedFilterToNeutral { dropUnresolvedConnected: true } — the optional filter port

name: a filter the Parse lowering refuses (pointsTo, no schema): Error is the refusal, Failure, no call
because: getStorageFilter's catch → `failed`; fetch() setError and returns

name: a Backend the project does not have: the not-configured sentence, Failure, no call; Items stays unset
because: fetch() — forBackend answers nothing

name: the first failure publishes the empty array; a later one keeps the rows already shown
because: REL-011b AC2 — only the first failure publishes `_c`

name: refused with no message: Error is `Failed to fetch.`
because: `err || 'Failed to fetch.'`

name: the Class box unticked: the Class is stored and nothing runs; Do queries with it
because: shouldRunOnValueChanged('collectionName', …) — the box; Do is not governed

name: the Query settings box unticked: a Limit change does not re-query; Do does
because: userInputSetter asks the Query settings box

name: a Do while a query is out is a second query; each answer publishes its own array
because: fetchScheduled is cleared before fetch() runs; each success closes over its own `_c`

name: the visual sort: one '-'-prefixed name per rule, in order
because: queryutils.ts convertVisualSorting

name: the retired QueryEditor shape reads the same as the builder's: a rule on a parameter
because: convertVisualFilterToNeutral — isVisualQueryFormat → visualQueryToNeutral

name: an empty Search sends none; an empty filter group narrows nothing
because: `this._internal.search || undefined`; savedFilterToNeutral of no conditions is null

name: an empty answer: Items is an empty array, Is Empty true, First Record Id unset, Success
because: the success publishes whatever came back

name: the Backend picker names the second backend: the query goes there
because: forBackend(modelScope, backendId)

name: a filter parameter's own box unticked: its change does not re-query
because: setQueryParameter asks `qp-<name>`'s own box

name: a write made elsewhere that matches the filter joins Items at the end (no sort); one that does not match, and one to another class, are not heard
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :251-363 cloudStoreEvents (s24) — create: Model.get(object.objectId), matchesQuery against the query made, `add` with no sort; :256 another class

name: under a sort a created record joins at its sorted place: before the first member that sorts after it
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :251-363 cloudStoreEvents (s24) :291-296 — compareObjects(sort, member, new) > 0 is where it goes

name: Limit under a DESCENDING sort: the record past the limit is dropped from the end — the new one when it sorts last
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :251-363 cloudStoreEvents (s24) :301-311 — a leading '-' on the first sort key drops the LAST

name: Limit under an ASCENDING sort drops the record that sorts LAST: a new record that sorts first stays and pushes the last out; one that sorts last is dropped again at once (v4, C40)
because: over Limit the end of the sorted list goes, under any sort — what the backend would answer (C40, fixed in P109 ISL-029 — v3 dropped the FIRST unless the first key was descending)

name: Limit with NO sort: a record that would go over the Limit asks the backend again — only it knows which records the Limit keeps (v4, C40)
because: with no sort, a join over Limit schedules the query again (C40, fixed in P109 ISL-029 — v3 appended it and dropped the first)

name: a member saved out of the filter leaves Items; a record saved into it joins
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :251-363 cloudStoreEvents (s24) :330-349 — save: Model.get(objectId), re-matched; the registry holds the write first

name: a member whose sort key moved moves to its new place: a save that still matches re-sorts Items (v4, C41)
because: a saved member that still matches is taken out and put back where it now sorts (C41, fixed in P109 ISL-029 — v3 left it in its old place)

name: a delete removes a member; a delete of a record not shown changes nothing
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :251-363 cloudStoreEvents (s24) :350-362

name: with a Search term a write re-queries instead: one query at the next frame
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :251-363 cloudStoreEvents (s24) :266-269 (BAK-008) — scheduleFetch

name: the Record changes box unticked: a write made elsewhere is not heard
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :251-363 cloudStoreEvents (s24) :253 — shouldRunOnValueChange('records')

name: before the first answer a write is not heard — nothing is held yet; once the rows landed, the next one joins
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :251-363 cloudStoreEvents (s24) :255 — `collection === undefined`

name: a write to another backend's store is not heard: the node listens to the store of the backend it queried
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :251-363 cloudStoreEvents (s24) :600-616, :851 — bindStoreEvents(cloudstore)

name: the Class as it is NOW is matched: a Class changed with its box unticked hears the new class's writes into the old rows
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :251-363 cloudStoreEvents (s24) :256 — `args.collection !== _internal.name`, read live

name: after the first failure a write joins the empty array it published
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :251-363 cloudStoreEvents (s24) :942 then :321-329 — the failure published an array; the query made is matched

name: slice C: Subscribe To Changes on with a Class — the query, then the subscribe `{ collection, primaryKey }` with NO filter though one is set; Realtime Status `connecting` at once (v2, D29 fixed), `subscribed` when the subscription says so
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :563-571 (the query first, then the reconnect), :707-714 (no where; v2 — the status read off the handle, D29), :778-786

name: slice C: realtime written before the Class in one frame — the reconnect was scheduled first, so the subscribe is made before the query
because: :650-663 then :563-571 — two scheduleAfterInputsHaveUpdated callbacks, run in the order scheduled

name: slice C: a create told — Change Type, Changed Record, Changed Records, Changed Record Id; Record Created then Records Changed; the query runs again at the next frame end
because: :745-776 — and :773-775 scheduleFetch under the Record changes box

name: slice C: Record changes unticked — a create is still told and pulsed, and nothing is queried again
because: :773-775 shouldRunOnValueChange('records')

name: slice C: init publishes the snapshot and pulses nothing, and re-queries nothing; an update pulses Record Updated; a key-only delete leaves Changed Record null and Changed Records empty with the id; resync pulses Records Changed alone
because: :749-761 (recordsComplete is the gate; init returns early), :767-772

name: slice C: an error told — Realtime Error and Realtime Failure; a later subscribed clears the error; a fatal one stops the subscription
because: :798-803; :778-784 a subscribed clears a held error; world.ts REALTIME — a fatal error tells stopped

error.message: The realtime connection went down before it was confirmed (errored).

name: slice C: a Backend the project has not — the query fails, then the reconnect says so on Realtime Error with the id as written; Failure then Realtime Failure
because: :1178-1188 (the query scheduled first), :844-850, :685-693

name: slice C: the same Class re-written keeps the subscription, and queries nothing (v5, C55)
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts setCollectionName: the reconnect only on a change (P109 ISL-030, P107-C55 ruled "Ignore repeated values"); v4 disposed the subscription and opened a new one

name: slice C: Subscribe To Changes off — torn down: disposed, Subscribed false and Realtime Status empty; the error held is kept
because: :650-653, :665-668 — the teardown first; the error is not cleared by it

name: slice C: the Backend switched — the query goes to other, then the subscription follows it there
because: :1178-1188 — BCN-008: the subscription follows the picker

name: slice C: no Class — realtime on subscribes to nothing
slice C: a subscription held, then Subscribe To Changes off and on again and Do in one frame — the old one disposed and a new one opened BEFORE the query
because: :650-663 scheduled first (by the off — a change; v5, C55: a same-value write schedules nothing, so v4's "written again" is now off-then-on), :1162-1169 Do second — the frame end runs them in that order

name: slice C: a subscription held, then Subscribe To Changes off and Do in one frame — disposed BEFORE the query; Do then the Class changed: the query before the reconnect
because: :650-663 then :1162-1169; then Do first, :563-571 second (v5, C55: the Class written is a CHANGE, Lesson to Note — a same-value write would reconnect nothing)

name: slice C: realtime on with no Class, then Do and the Class in a later frame — the reconnect asked for after the query this time, so the query is made first (a reconnect flag left set would put the subscribe first)
because: :656-663 — the flag clears when the reconnect runs, quiet or not

name: slice C: Subscribe To Changes then a Backend the project has not, in one frame — the reconnect fails first: Realtime Failure, then Failure
slice C: Record changes unticked — create, update, a whole delete and resync each told and pulsed, the Change outputs moving each time, and nothing queried again
because: :745-776 with shouldRunOnValueChange('records') false

name: slice C: a filter the translator refuses beside a quiet reconnect (realtime on, no Class) — Failure; then Do, a good filter and the Class: the query before the subscribe (a reconnect flag left set would put the subscribe first)
because: :656-663 the flag clears when the reconnect runs, quiet or not; :983 the refusal

name: slice C: a subscription that never answers: the same Class written twice keeps it (v5, C55); realtime off disposes it, and on again opens another (Realtime Status empty throughout)
because: :717-727 the teardown disposes what is held; :707-713 the status is never read; v5 (C55): a same-value Class write no longer reconnects

name: slice C: the Class, realtime and a refused filter in one frame — Error and Failure, the subscription opened anyway; realtime off then disposes it
because: :983 the query refused; :707-713 the subscription takes no filter; :665-668

name: slice C: a subscription still connecting and a second query, then Subscribe To Changes off and Do in one frame — disposed before the query, whose answer lands as Items; on again opens a new one
because: :650-663 then :1162-1169; :717-727 (v2: the `connecting` read at the subscribe cleared — Realtime Status empty)

name: slice C: a subscription still connecting (the third), then a refused filter and Subscribe To Changes off in one frame — Error and Failure, the third disposed; on again opens a fourth
because: :983 the refusal; :717-727 the teardown clears the `connecting` read at the subscribe (v2); v5 (C55): the second and third subscriptions come from two CHANGES of the Class (Note, then Lesson) — a same-value write reconnects nothing

name: Fetch total count with no wire out of Total Count: the call still asks for it and the total is stored, but nothing is sent on a port nobody wired
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :927-930 — the count is stored, and flagged only `if (this.hasOutput('storageTotalCount'))`; the output exists only when a wire registers it (:1146-1153). NSP-020 s84

name: a filter parameter arriving alone, after the query ran, re-queries with it: the second call narrows on n > 2 and searches nothing
because: dbcollectionnode2.ts :1169-1176 setQueryParameter — stored, and under its own ticked box (a changed value) the frame's query is scheduled; the call reads it through the filter (:1061-1098). NSP-020 s84: kills the swap of this branch with Search's, which generated sequences reach on some seeds only
